description: "Summon an effigy of bone for 11 seconds that grants Minor Protection to you and your allies, reducing damage taken by 5%. Enemies in the area are afflicted with Major Cowardice, reducing their Weapon and Spell Damage by 430.\n\nAfter 2 seconds, the totem begins fearing nearby enemies every 2 seconds, causing them to cower in place for 4 seconds."
